language.title: Commit message language
language.description: Any language name, for example English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese or 繁體中文; it is passed to the model as written. 'auto' or blank follows the IDE interface language. Chinese and English stay shortcuts for their long names.

maxDiffChars.title: Maximum diff characters
maxDiffChars.description: The prompt budget after the IDE's own 1 MiB pending-commit limit.

commitTypes.title: Allowed commit types
commitTypes.description: Title is the value the model must return; description explains when to pick it and is included in the prompt. Older string-only lists are still accepted.

default.title: style
default.description: Formatting or style, no behaviour change

default.title: refactor
default.description: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

actionGenerate.title: Show the Generate button
actionGenerate.description: The two buttons above the commit message. A hidden button is removed from the toolbar; the command stays available in Find Action.

actionGenerateWithContext.title: Show the Generate with Requirements button
